headline: Parkash Chand resigns as non-executive director of TFCI
hook: Board departure at Tourism Finance Corporation
summary: Tourism Finance Corporation of India Limited has announced that Mr Parkash Chand has resigned from his position as a Non-Executive Director. The resignation takes effect from October 13, 2026. No immediate replacement or reason for the departure was disclosed in the filing. Retail investors track board changes for potential shifts in corporate governance.
why_it_matters: Routine board exit with no immediate impact on share value.
